- Returns a plain-text invoice formatted for customers

- Last line: Total: [formatted total]

**10 comprehensive tests** covering:
- Draft vs. issued invoices
- Customer name display
- Line item formatting with quantities and prices
- Multiple lines with correct totals
- Large amounts with comma formatting
- VAT-exempt products
- Multi-line text output structure

INV-2025-0001
Kite & Co
3 × Design work (hour) @ €85.00 = €255.00

```
